subject: prd/tech-design-review
statement: When the verdict is escalate, the reviewer shall emit the decision brief as data and the subject shall be treated as parked — not advancing, consuming nothing, its state recorded — with surfacing owned by the surrounding flow per the pair convention.
rationale: terminating exception, not a wait (inherited, brainstorm:authoring-reviewers#D-3)
fit_criterion: schema-valid briefs; parked state recorded; no retry loop
